  <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px"><div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:700">Sources &amp; accuracy notes</div><div class="grow"></div><button class="b" id="srcclose">Close ✕</button></div>
  <p class="fine" style="font-size:12px">Content checked in November 2026 against the GINA 2025 strategy report and the literature below. The model is simplified for teaching: it compresses minutes and hours into seconds and shows one idealised airway.</p>
  <ul class="srcl">
    <li><a href="https://ginasthma.org/2025-gina-strategy-report/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">GINA 2025 Global Strategy for Asthma Management and Prevention</a>: SABA-only treatment not recommended; ICS-formoterol is the preferred reliever</li>
    <li><a href="https://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/fda-approves-drug-combination-treatment-adults-asthma" target="_blank" rel="noopener">FDA: Airsupra (albuterol/budesonide) approval</a>, the first ICS-SABA reliever in the US (adults)</li>
    <li><a href="https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK542249/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">StatPearls: Beta-2 adrenergic agonists</a>: albuterol onset and mechanism</li>
    <li><a href="https://pharmacology2000.com/Pharmacology2000_Content_File/Pulm-01-content.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Airway smooth-muscle signalling</a>: Gs → adenylyl cyclase → cAMP → PKA; MLCK inactivated, myosin phosphatase activated</li>
    <li><a href="https://link.springer.com/10.1007/s12016-018-8720-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Komi &amp; Bjermer 2019: mast cells in allergic asthma</a>: histamine, PGD₂ and LTC₄ cause bronchoconstriction, edema and mucus secretion</li>
    <li><a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC408423" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Early- and late-phase asthmatic responses</a>: timing of the early and late responses</li>
    <li><a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7066101" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Jartti et al. 2020: viruses as asthma triggers</a>: rhinovirus is the most common trigger of attacks</li>
    <li><a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8074657" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Gregory et al. 2021: modelling wheezing</a>: flutter of nearly collapsed airways</li>
    <li><a href="https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/fmolb.2021.717771/full" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Jin et al. 2021</a>: airway smooth muscle forms helically winding bundles</li>
    <li><a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC462049" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Newman et al. 1989: MDI lung deposition</a>: about 11% of the dose reaches the lungs without a spacer</li>
  </ul>

function simState(t) {
  const spasm = ss(23, 32, t) * (1 - 0.94 * ss(50, 62, t));
  const swell = ss(20, 36, t) * (0.75 - 0.15 * ss(52, 70, t));
  const mucus = ss(25, 38, t) * (1 - 0.15 * ss(55, 70, t));
  const act = ss(47.5, 51.5, t) * (1 - 0.25 * ss(64, 70, t));
  const kM = 1 - 0.3 * spasm;
  const Rl = kM - 0.17 * swell;                 // mean lumen radius (healthy = 1)
  const Reff = Math.max(0.25, Rl - 0.04 * mucus);
  const flow = Math.pow(Reff, 4);
  return { spasm, swell, mucus, act, kM, kA: 1 - 0.22 * spasm, kV: 1 - 0.21 * spasm, Rl, Reff, flow, distress: clamp((1 - flow) * 1.15) };
}

function renderPath(P) {
  let h = `<h3 style="color:${P.c}">${P.title}</h3><div class="steps" style="--pc:${P.c}">`;
  P.steps.forEach((s, i) => { h += (i ? '<div class="arrow"></div>' : '') + `<div class="step" data-t="${s[1]}"><div class="n">${i + 1}</div><div>${s[0]}</div></div>`; });
  h += '</div>';
  if (P.effects) h += '<div class="arrow"></div><div class="effects">' + P.effects.map((e) => `<div class="eff" data-t="${e[1]}">${e[0]}</div>`).join('') + '</div>';
  $('#path').innerHTML = h; $('#path').dataset.kind = P.title;
}

// Fake "cap" for the cutaway: back faces seen through the cut are the inside of solid tissue -> flat cut colour.
function capify(m, hex) {
  m.side = THREE.DoubleSide;
  m.onBeforeCompile = (sh) => {
    sh.uniforms.uCap = { value: new THREE.Color(hex) };
    sh.fragmentShader = 'uniform vec3 uCap;\n' + sh.fragmentShader.replace('#include <tonemapping_fragment>',
      'if (!gl_FrontFacing) { gl_FragColor = vec4(uCap * (0.82 + 0.18 * vNormal.y), 1.0); }\n#include <tonemapping_fragment>');
  };
  m.customProgramCacheKey = () => 'cap' + hex;
}
capify(mats.mucosa, '#e9a7a3'); capify(mats.muscle, '#a3222c'); capify(mats.artery, '#7a0c14'); capify(mats.vein, '#2a2070'); capify(mats.receptor, '#1f6f80');

function makePoints(n, size, additive = true) {
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(n * 3), 3));
  g.setAttribute('aAlpha', new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(n), 1));
  g.setAttribute('aSize', new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(n).fill(1), 1));
  g.setAttribute('aColor', new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(n * 3).fill(1), 3));
  const m = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: { uSize: { value: size }, uScale: { value: 400 } },
    vertexShader: `attribute float aAlpha; attribute float aSize; attribute vec3 aColor; varying float vA; varying vec3 vC; uniform float uSize; uniform float uScale;
      void main(){ vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.); gl_Position = projectionMatrix*mv; gl_PointSize = uSize*aSize*uScale*projectionMatrix[1][1]/max(0.1,-mv.z); vA = aAlpha; vC = aColor; }`,
    fragmentShader: `varying float vA; varying vec3 vC; void main(){ vec2 c = gl_PointCoord-.5; float d = length(c); if(d>.5) discard; float a = smoothstep(.5,0.,d); a*=a; gl_FragColor = vec4(vC*(0.7+0.9*a), a*vA); }`,
    transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: additive ? THREE.AdditiveBlending : THREE.NormalBlending,
  });
  const p = new THREE.Points(g, m); p.frustumCulled = false; p.n = n;
  p.P = g.attributes.position.array; p.A = g.attributes.aAlpha.array; p.S = g.attributes.aSize.array; p.C = g.attributes.aColor.array;
  p.flush = () => { g.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true; g.attributes.aAlpha.needsUpdate = true; g.attributes.aSize.needsUpdate = true; g.attributes.aColor.needsUpdate = true; };
  p.setColor = (i, c) => { p.C[i * 3] = c.r; p.C[i * 3 + 1] = c.g; p.C[i * 3 + 2] = c.b; };
  return p;
}

function pollenGeo() {
  const g = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 3);
  const dirs = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 0).attributes.position;
  const D = []; for (let i = 0; i < dirs.count; i++) D.push(new THREE.Vector3().fromBufferAttribute(dirs, i).normalize());
  const p = g.attributes.position, v = new THREE.Vector3();
  for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
    v.fromBufferAttribute(p, i).normalize();
    let m = 0; for (const d of D) m = Math.max(m, Math.pow(Math.max(0, v.dot(d)), 30));
    v.multiplyScalar(1 + 0.6 * m); p.setXYZ(i, v.x, v.y, v.z);
  }
  g.computeVertexNormals(); return g;
}

function alongPath(P, f, out) { const d = f * P.L; let k = 1; while (k < P.cum.length - 1 && P.cum[k] < d) k++; const t = (d - P.cum[k - 1]) / Math.max(1e-6, P.cum[k] - P.cum[k - 1]); return out.lerpVectors(P.pts[k - 1], P.pts[k], clamp(t)); }

}

/* =============================================================== BREATH GRAPH */
const gc = $('#graph'), g2 = gc.getContext('2d');
const hist = [];
function breathFlow(ph, fi) { // normalised flow, + = inhale
  if (ph < fi) return Math.sin(Math.PI * ph / fi);
  return -Math.sin(Math.PI * (ph - fi) / (1 - fi)) * (fi / (1 - fi));
}
function breathVol(ph, fi) { return ph < fi ? (1 - Math.cos(Math.PI * ph / fi)) / 2 : (1 + Math.cos(Math.PI * (ph - fi) / (1 - fi))) / 2; }
function drawGraph(stageColor) {
  const w = gc.clientWidth, h = gc.clientHeight, d = Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2);
  if (gc.width !== w * d) { gc.width = w * d; gc.height = h * d; }
  g2.setTransform(d, 0, 0, d, 0, 0); g2.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
  g2.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,180,230,.18)'; g2.lineWidth = 1; g2.beginPath(); g2.moveTo(0, h / 2); g2.lineTo(w, h / 2); g2.stroke();
  if (hist.length < 2) return;
  const tmax = hist[hist.length - 1].t, span = 9;
  g2.lineWidth = 2; g2.lineJoin = 'round';
  for (let i = 1; i < hist.length; i++) {
    const a = hist[i - 1], b = hist[i];
    g2.strokeStyle = b.c; g2.beginPath();
    g2.moveTo(w * (1 - (tmax - a.t) / span), h / 2 - a.f * h * 0.42);
    g2.lineTo(w * (1 - (tmax - b.t) / span), h / 2 - b.f * h * 0.42); g2.stroke();
  }
  while (hist.length && tmax - hist[0].t > span) hist.shift();
}
const STAGE_HEX = { healthy: '#5fd4a0', trigger: '#f2b24a', attack: '#ff5a5f', albuterol: '#3ad6ff', relief: '#9be27d' };

function b64ToBuf(b64) { const bin = atob(b64); const u = new Uint8Array(bin.length); for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) u[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i); return u.buffer; }
const loader = new GLTFLoader();

  });
  for (const [nm, o] of Object.entries(parts)) {

  }

  goView('lungs', true);
  $('#loading').style.opacity = 0; setTimeout(() => $('#loading').remove(), 600);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}, (err) => { $('#ltxt').innerHTML = `<div id="err">Couldn't load the 3D model: ${err?.message || err}</div>`; });

function setMorph(o, name, v) { if (!o || !o.morphTargetDictionary) return; const i = o.morphTargetDictionary[name]; if (i !== undefined) o.morphTargetInfluences[i] = v; }

/* =============================================================== FRAME */
const tmpM = new THREE.Matrix4(), tmpQ = new THREE.Quaternion(), tmpV = new THREE.Vector3(), tmpS = new THREE.Vector3(), tmpE = new THREE.Euler();
let last = performance.now(), wall = 0;
function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000); last = now; wall += dt;
  if (playing && !scrubbing) { simT += dt * speed; if (simT >= T_END) { simT = T_END; playing = false; } }
  const sdt = (playing && !scrubbing) ? dt * speed : 0;
  const t = simT, S = simState(t), st = stageAt(t);
  if (autoCam) goView(autoView(t));

  // ---- breathing
  const period = lerp(3.8, 2.1, S.distress), fi = lerp(0.42, 0.3, S.distress);
  breathPh = (breathPh + sdt / period) % 1;
  const amp = Math.sqrt(S.flow);
  let bf = breathFlow(breathPh, fi);
  const wheezing = S.flow < 0.35 && bf < 0;
  let disp = bf * lerp(1, 0.6, 1 - amp) * (0.35 + 0.65 * amp);
  if (wheezing) disp += Math.sin(wall * 90) * 0.06 * (0.35 - S.flow) / 0.35 * Math.abs(bf) * 2;
  if (sdt > 0) hist.push({ t: (hist.length ? hist[hist.length - 1].t : 0) + sdt, f: disp, c: STAGE_HEX[st.id] });
  $('#wheeze').style.opacity = wheezing ? 1 : 0;

  // ---- airway morphs / materials
  for (const n of ['AW_Mucosa', 'AW_Muscle', 'AW_Receptors', 'AW_Adventitia', 'AW_Artery', 'AW_Vein']) setMorph(parts[n], 'Constrict', S.spasm);
  setMorph(parts.AW_Mucosa, 'Swell', S.swell);
  setMorph(parts.AW_Mucus, 'Grow', S.mucus);
  parts.AW_Mucus.visible = S.mucus > 0.01;
  parts.AW_Mucus.scale.set(1, S.kM, S.kM);
  mats.mucosa.color.set('#d9646f').lerp(new THREE.Color('#e3303e'), S.swell * 0.75);
  mats.mucosa.emissive.set('#5a0610'); mats.mucosa.emissiveIntensity = S.swell * 0.55;
  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(wall * 5);
  mats.muscle.emissive.set('#ff1a28'); mats.muscle.emissiveIntensity = S.spasm * (0.25 + 0.3 * pulse);
  mats.receptor.emissiveIntensity = S.act * (2.4 + 0.8 * Math.sin(wall * 7)) + 0.12;
  lumenLight.intensity = 0.8 + 1.4 * S.Reff;

  // ---- lungs view
  setMorph(parts.OV_Bronchi, 'Constrict', S.spasm);
  mats.bronchi.emissive.set(S.act > 0.05 && S.spasm < 0.5 ? '#2ad0ff' : '#ff1e30');
  mats.bronchi.emissiveIntensity = S.spasm * (0.35 + 0.35 * pulse) + S.act * (1 - S.spasm) * 0.25 * (1 - ss(60, 70, t));
  mats.lung.uniforms.uMix.value = S.spasm * 0.6;
  const vol = breathVol(breathPh, fi);
  const ls = 1 + 0.035 * vol * (0.4 + 0.6 * amp) + 0.03 * S.spasm;    // air trapping -> hyper-inflation
  parts.OV_LungLeft.scale.setScalar(ls); parts.OV_LungRight.scale.setScalar(ls);
  marker.lookAt(camera.position); marker.scale.setScalar(1 + 0.25 * Math.sin(wall * 4)); marker.material.opacity = 0.55 + 0.35 * Math.sin(wall * 4);
  inhaler.visible = t > 38.5 && t < 46;
  
  inhaler.children[2].position.y = 1.25 - 0.12 * ss(40.1, 40.3, t) * (1 - ss(41, 41.4, t));

  // ---- particles: air in airway
  const R = S.Reff * 0.84;
  const turb = S.distress;
  airCol.copy(cAir).lerp(cAirBad, turb * 0.6);
  for (let i = 0; i < NAIR; i++) {
    const p = airS[i];
    const v = 4.6 * bf * (0.25 + 0.75 * amp) * (1 - p.u * p.u) * (0.8 + 0.4 * p.j);
    p.x += v * sdt;
    if (p.x > 7.3) p.x -= 14.6; if (p.x < -7.3) p.x += 14.6;
    const jx = turb * 0.09 * Math.sin(wall * 9 + i), ja = turb * 0.12 * Math.sin(wall * 7 + i * 1.7);
    const r = p.u * R + jx;
    air.P[i * 3] = p.x; air.P[i * 3 + 1] = r * Math.cos(p.a + ja); air.P[i * 3 + 2] = r * Math.sin(p.a + ja);
    const edge = clamp((7.3 - Math.abs(p.x)) / 0.9);
    air.A[i] = 0.42 * edge * (cutaway && view === 'airway' && air.P[i * 3 + 2] > 0.05 ? 0.55 : 1);
    air.setColor(i, airCol);
  }
  air.flush();

  // ---- allergens
  for (let i = 0; i < NAL; i++) {
    const A = AL[i];
    if (t < A.ts) { tmpS.setScalar(0); tmpM.compose(tmpV.set(0, 0, 0), tmpQ, tmpS); allergenMesh.setMatrixAt(i, tmpM); continue; }
    const p = clamp((t - A.ts) / A.dur), e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 2);
    const x = lerp(-7.4, A.xs, e) + (1 - p) * 0.2 * Math.sin(t * 3 + i);
    const wallR = S.Rl * 0.97;
    const r = lerp(A.u0 * S.Rl, wallR, p * p);
    tmpV.set(x, r * Math.cos(A.a), r * Math.sin(A.a));
    tmpE.set(t * (1 - p) * 2 + i, t * (1 - p) * 1.3, i); tmpQ.setFromEuler(tmpE);
    tmpS.setScalar(A.s * (0.6 + 0.4 * ss(0, 0.15, p)));
    tmpM.compose(tmpV, tmpQ, tmpS); allergenMesh.setMatrixAt(i, tmpM);
  }
  allergenMesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
  allergenMesh.material.emissiveIntensity = 0.5 + 0.4 * (1 - ss(30, 45, t));

  // ---- mediators: from stuck allergen into the muscle layer
  for (let i = 0; i < NMED; i++) {
    const M = MED[i], A = AL[M.k];
    const q = (t - M.tb) / M.life;
    if (q < 0 || q > 1 || M.tb > 36) { med.A[i] = 0; continue; }
    const r = lerp(S.Rl * 0.97, 1.37 * S.kM, q);
    const a = A.a + M.da * q;
    med.P[i * 3] = A.xs + M.dx * q; med.P[i * 3 + 1] = r * Math.cos(a); med.P[i * 3 + 2] = r * Math.sin(a);
    med.A[i] = 0.9 * Math.sin(Math.PI * q); med.S[i] = 0.7 + 0.6 * rnd(i, 3);
  }
  med.flush();

  // ---- albuterol in airway: fly in, land, diffuse to muscle, bind
  for (let i = 0; i < NDR; i++) {
    const D = DR[i];
    if (t < D.ts) { drug.A[i] = 0; continue; }
    const p = clamp((t - D.ts) / D.dur), e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 2.2);
    let x, r, alpha = 0.95;
    if (D.pass) { x = lerp(-7.4, 7.4, (t - D.ts) / (D.dur * 1.4)); r = D.u0 * S.Reff * 0.8; alpha = clamp((7.4 - Math.abs(x)) / 0.8) * 0.8; if (x >= 7.4) alpha = 0; }
    else {
      x = lerp(-7.4, D.xs, e);
      r = lerp(D.u0 * S.Rl, S.Rl * 0.97, p * p);
      const q = (t - D.ts - D.dur) / D.diff;
      if (q > 0) { r = lerp(S.Rl * 0.97, 1.37 * S.kM, clamp(q)); alpha = q < 1 ? 0.95 : Math.max(0, 0.95 - (q - 1) * 1.2); }
    }
    const a = D.a + (1 - p) * 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 2 + i);
    drug.P[i * 3] = x; drug.P[i * 3 + 1] = r * Math.cos(a); drug.P[i * 3 + 2] = r * Math.sin(a);
    drug.A[i] = alpha; drug.S[i] = 0.8 + 0.5 * rnd(i, 7);
  }
  drug.flush();

  // ---- lungs view: drug mist down the tree, inhaler puff, gentle air
  for (let i = 0; i < NOD; i++) {
    const O = OD[i];
    const p = (t - O.ts) / O.dur;
    if (p < 0 || p > 1.6) { odrug.A[i] = 0; continue; }
    alongPath(O.path, clamp(1 - Math.pow(1 - clamp(p), 1.6)), tmpV).add(O.j);
    odrug.P[i * 3] = tmpV.x; odrug.P[i * 3 + 1] = tmpV.y; odrug.P[i * 3 + 2] = tmpV.z;
    odrug.A[i] = p < 1 ? 0.6 : 0.6 * (1 - (p - 1) / 0.6);
  }
  odrug.flush();
  for (let i = 0; i < 160; i++) {
    const q = (t - 40.15 - 0.6 * rnd(i, 61)) / 1.1;
    if (q < 0 || q > 1) { puff.A[i] = 0; continue; }
    const a = TAU * rnd(i, 62), sp = 0.25 * rnd(i, 63);
    puff.P[i * 3] = Math.cos(a) * sp * q; puff.P[i * 3 + 1] = 3.5 - 0.3 * q; puff.P[i * 3 + 2] = 0.25 + Math.sin(a) * sp * q;
    puff.A[i] = 0.8 * (1 - q);
  }
  puff.flush();
  for (let i = 0; i < NAIRO; i++) {
    const O = OA[i];
    const f = clamp(O.f0 * 0.9 + 0.1 + (vol - 0.5) * 0.35 * O.sp * (0.3 + 0.7 * amp));
    alongPath(O.path, f, tmpV);
    oair.P[i * 3] = tmpV.x; oair.P[i * 3 + 1] = tmpV.y; oair.P[i * 3 + 2] = tmpV.z;
    oair.A[i] = 0.28; oair.setColor(i, cAir);
  }
  oair.flush();

  // ---- camera animation
  if (camAnim) {
    camAnim.t += dt; const k = ss(0, 1, camAnim.t / camAnim.dur);
    camera.position.lerpVectors(camAnim.from, camAnim.to, k);
    if (camAnim.t >= camAnim.dur) camAnim = null;
  }
  controls.update();
  composer.render();

  // ---- labels
  if (showLabels) {
    const w = innerWidth, h = innerHeight;
    for (const L of LABELS) {
      const res = L.view === view ? L.fn(S, L.v) : null;
      if (!res) { L.el.style.opacity = 0; continue; }
      tmpV.copy(L.v).project(camera);
      const vis = tmpV.z < 1 && Math.abs(tmpV.x) < 1.1 && Math.abs(tmpV.y) < 1.1;
      L.el.style.opacity = vis ? 1 : 0;
      L.el.style.left = ((tmpV.x + 1) / 2 * w) + 'px'; L.el.style.top = ((1 - tmpV.y) / 2 * h) + 'px';
    }
  }

  // ---- UI
  if (st.id !== lastStage) {
    lastStage = st.id;
    $('#story').innerHTML = STORY[st.id]; $('#story').style.setProperty('--sc', st.c);
    document.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach((c) => c.classList.toggle('on', c.dataset.id === st.id));
  }
  const P = t >= 40 ? PATH_DRUG : PATH_ATTACK;
  if (P.title !== lastPathKind) { lastPathKind = P.title; renderPath(P); }
  document.querySelectorAll('#path [data-t]').forEach((el) => el.classList.toggle('on', t >= +el.dataset.t));
  $('#mR').textContent = Math.round(S.Rl * 100) + '%';
  $('#mF').textContent = Math.round(S.flow * 100) + '%';
  $('#mX').textContent = (1 / S.flow).toFixed(1) + '×';
  $('#mF').style.color = S.flow < 0.25 ? 'var(--attack)' : S.flow < 0.6 ? 'var(--trigger)' : 'var(--healthy)';
  $('#mX').style.color = $('#mF').style.color;
  for (const [b, v, val] of [['#bS', '#vS', S.spasm], ['#bW', '#vW', S.swell], ['#bM', '#vM', S.mucus], ['#bA', '#vA', S.act]]) { $(b).style.width = (val * 100) + '%'; $(v).textContent = Math.round(val * 100); }
  $('#time').textContent = `${t.toFixed(1)} s · ${st.name}`;
  if (!scrubbing) $('#scrub').value = t;
  $('#tlprog').style.width = (t / T_END * 100) + '%';
  $('#play').textContent = playing ? '❚❚' : '▶';
  drawGraph(STAGE_HEX[st.id]);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
